model.name: DirRef.resolveDirRefAbs
model.description: Resolve a dir:<repo-rel> ref to its absolute disk path via ONE PROJECT_ROOT-join (root param injectable for scratch/R40.31). Correct-by-construction: all dir: refs uniform repo-relative -> no src-vs-repo discriminator. Used by createPhysicalWithUnit (mkdir base) + sourceDirTree (walk base) + ensureViewUnit-location.
